paragraphs.text: Thryx is a legendary elemental giant on Theros , a being of sea and storms.

Thryx is a follower of Thassa , and despite his massive size, he can fly across the skies on clouds of thunder. Even in the mountain fortresses of Akros , far from the sea, the Akroans have learned not to anger the sea goddess, lest they first-hand experience the wrath of Thryx.

Thryx strikes an imposing figure, with violet skin, blue glowing eyes, and a massively muscled and scarred physique. His long white hair and sideburns streak in the wind, and he surrounds himself with booming storm clouds and flashing lightning. Rage marks his face, and his presence is terrible to behold.
